data: {"content_index":0,"item_id":"","logprobs":[],"output_index":0,"sequence_number":434,"text":"I recommend **Tokyo, JP** for the Vergil-inspired outdoor shoot on **2026-10-18, 15:00–18:00**.\n\nAcross the full window, Tokyo is more workable and controllable. Those values give mild temperatures, moderate cloud cover, and a manageable breeze.\n\nParis is moodier but riskier: **14°C, 60% precipitation, 80% cloud cover, 18 kph wind at 15:00**; **13°C, 65% precipitation, 85% cloud cover, 19 kph wind at 16:00**; **12°C, 70% precipitation, 90% cloud cover, 21 kph wind at 17:00**; and **11°C, 70% precipitation, 90% cloud cover, 20 kph wind at 18:00**. The heavy cloud cover suits the cold mood, but precipitation risk and stronger wind could complicate costume control, blade safety, and continuity.\n\nTokyo better supports the image-derived cues: the deep navy/black/silver palette will read cleanly under **45–60% cloud cover**, avoiding harsh glare while still allowing edge highlights on silver hair and katana. The **11–13 kph wind** is enough to move the long blue coat subtly without overpowering its narrow, structured silhouette.
